items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S558

SPONSOR: BENJAMIN
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the banking law, the tax law, the executive law, the
estates, powers and trusts law, the public health law, the real property
law and the general obligations law, in relation to providing for the
remote conduct of certain practices and procedures

 
PURPOSE:

To modernize various provisions in state law relating to remote meet-
ings, remote notarization and other processes. Codifies Executive Orders
of 2020: EO 202.5, EO 202.7, EO 202.8, EO 202.13, EO 202.14, EO 202.15,
and EO 202.18.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1 amends section 11 of the banking law by adding a new subdivi-
sion 5 allowing for fax or other electronic copies.

§ 2 adds new subdivision twenty-ninth to allow for digital signature in
lieu of handwritten signatures on documents related to tax liability.

§ 3 amends the executive law by adding a new section 137-a to allow for
electronic notary services.

§ 4 amends the estates, powers, and trusts law section 3-2.1 adding a
new paragraph c to allow for electronic attestations of wills

§ 5 amends the estates, powers, and trusts law for electronic signatures
and witnessing thereof

§ 6 amends the public health law section 2981 for electronic witnessing
of health care proxies.

§ 7 amends the public health law section 4201 to accommodate electronic
assignment of responsibility for the disposal of human remains.

§ 8 amends the real property law by adding new section 304-a to allow
for witnessing of signatures via audio-video technology.

§ 9 amends the general obligations law to recognize changes in § 4 of
this bill. § 15 sets the effective date.

 
EXISTING LAW:

Current law requires physical presence for a number of routine business
procedures.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

The public health emergency arising from COVID-19 has revealed a number
of small chokepoints in business practices that can be cleared by adopt-
ing more modern technology. The executive has issued a number of execu-
tive orders under the emergency to remove such barriers. This legis-
lation codifies such changes.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

58317/A10569

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None.

 
LOCAL FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
Thirty days after passage.
